mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20d forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL crossing above 264.0 triggers inflation concerns, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate higher interest rates.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in >60% of triggered instances despite CPIAUCSL crossing above 264.0

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in GDPC1 (demand) and fall in INDPRO (supply) creates upward pressure on asset prices, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-month rolling window despite positive interaction

mechanism_narrative: In the late-cycle expansion regime, lower FEDFUNDS rates and rising GDPC1 signal growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns in late-cycle expansion periods not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05)

mechanism_narrative: A decline in UNRATE below 5.0% and rise in PAYEMS (employment) signal tight labor markets, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns not positive despite UNRATE < 5.0 and PAYEMS increase

mechanism_narrative: UNRATE crossing below 5.0% triggers expectations of tight labor markets, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in >60% of UNRATE <5.0 instances

mechanism_narrative: Rising GDPC1 (demand) and HOUST (household spending) simultaneously strengthen demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 6-month window despite positive demand interaction

mechanism_narrative: Contraction in INDPRO (supply) and rising FEDFUNDS (tightening) signal contractionary policies, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns not negative in >60% of INDPRO contraction-FEDFUNDS tightening instances
